limitations: Completed stage durations are inclusive; nested K/Laplace stages overlap and must not be added.

Motion-causal cohorts require an accepted coordinator packet before physical stamp 90 seconds. Endpoint-only and later/unadopted work are separate.
Unfinished stages have elapsed age and prior proc CPU sample, never a claimed completed duration.
An incomplete final JSONL line is ignored; fixed byte prefixes and hashes are recorded.
ROS publication-call completion is measured; subscriber receipt and RViz GPU completion are not.
Recording and simultaneous cases add CPU/GPU load; these are not isolated performance measurements.
